A.writes: paired +2048/-2048, each command counted separately; cycles complete before exit
A.distribution: Uniform keys and uniform read members; write members are partitioned by connection ID to avoid concurrent writes to the same member.
A.load_method: Identical sorted ZADD batches of 8192 members on all products, one loading connection per key; initialization excluded. Avoid a 410 MB RESTORE exceeding ordinary per-worker request admission without tuning connection buffers.

B.update: ZADD XX existing member; no accidental recreation
B.initial_ttl: staggered residual TTL represents pre-aged population
B.assumptions: PDF does not specify update load or TTL staggering. Churn and update throughput must be recorded separately; report failure to maintain population rather than normalize it away.
B.member_ids: 32-byte deterministic IDs, distinct between match keys (ID=key_index*50+member_index)

C.logical_cold: remaining 10% of traffic selects keys outside hot set; does not imply a physical disk miss
C.scope: 20.48 GB five-product comparison; original-size C is a separate extension
C.validation_detail: All reads check exact field set, 128-byte lengths, embedded key/field IDs and valid version encoding. Full checks compare deterministic suffixes. Immutable f01..f15 retain version 0; mutable f00 may contain any self-consistent version produced by concurrent writes. This is content integrity checking, not a full linearizability history audit.
C.value_layout: Each 128-byte field value has 48 ASCII hexadecimal bytes identifying key, field and version, followed by an 80-byte deterministic binary suffix. Structured prefixes are compressible; this is not an incompressible-random-data benchmark.

measurement.report: white HTML, sources linked; per-command latency; no average of percentiles
measurement.profiling: separate from formal timing; no continuous monitoring in timed short windows
measurement.persistence: record actual per-product configuration; do not present memory-only and durable writes as equivalent
measurement.validation: count and full logical content verification at load; per-reply structure and deterministic expected values where stable; post-write recovery and final content checks
measurement.maintenance: Normal Lavik engine maintenance. Host maintenance timers held during tests and restored afterwards.
measurement.C_timed_validation: Every reply checks shape, lengths and key/field/version identity; full deterministic suffix checked on 1 in 1024 reads per connection. Full content verification before and after measurement.

C_original_size.validation: Full 100M Hash content verification before and after timing; same per-reply checks as the 20 GB client.
